instruction: Candid documentary wide full shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, shaking hands with the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) who stands on the right facing left. They clasp right hands under bright overhead lighting.

R1 faces left toward R2 while clasping R2's right hand
R1 and R2 clasp each other's right hands
